metas.name: Up
metas.description: A heartfelt adventure that balances emotional depth with exciting travel, perfect for fans of Inside Out 2.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: A creative and funny world-building story that matches the humor and heart of Toy Story and Zootopia.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: High-stakes family superhero action that fans of Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse will love.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A beautiful coming-of-age story about friendship and secret identities, similar to Turning Red.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A colorful and imaginative story about connection and family expectations, echoing the themes of Encanto.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: An action-packed adventure featuring a lovable robot, perfect for fans of the Sonic the Hedgehog movies.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A fun, video-game-inspired journey that will appeal to fans of The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An epic fantasy adventure with stunning flight sequences that matches the energy of Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: A universally beloved family comedy that is as charming and wholesome as My Neighbor Totoro.

metas.name: Klaus
metas.description: A beautifully animated holiday story with a unique visual style and plenty of humor for fans of The Grinch.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: A hilarious look at what animals do when humans aren't home, perfect for fans of Migration and Rio.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: A high-energy, wacky comedy with a lot of heart, similar to the slapstick style of Shrek.

metas.name: The Lorax
metas.description: A bright and musical Dr. Seuss adaptation that fans of The Grinch and Sing will enjoy.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A fast-paced animal comedy with a memorable cast of characters, much like Despicable Me.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A funny and clever subversion of superhero tropes that fans of The Bad Guys will appreciate.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A family-centric prehistoric adventure filled with humor and discovery, similar to Moana.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A magical journey across beautiful landscapes with a musical core, appealing to fans of Moana and Ponyo.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: A touching story about family (ohana) and finding where you belong, similar to Turning Red.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: The original musical phenomenon that established the characters seen in the kids' watch of Frozen II.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A classic Pixar tale of friendship and sportsmanship that fans of Toy Story will enjoy.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: An underdog story with great group dynamics and humor, perfect for fans of Chicken Run.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A fantasy quest centered on brotherhood, blending modern life with magic like Howl's Moving Castle.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A classic Disney-style musical adventure that explores the magic of wishing, similar to Tangled.

metas.name: The LEGO Movie
metas.description: An incredibly creative and funny film with a deep message about imagination and play.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A family-friendly monster comedy that is more silly than scary, perfect for fans of The Grinch.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: A spin-off featuring the breakout stars of Despicable Me, focused on pure slapstick comedy.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: The continuation of Po's journey that brings the trilogy's themes of family and destiny to a close.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: The delightful sequel to Finding Nemo that explores Dory's own family history.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: A fun school-setting prequel that expands the world of Mike and Sulley from Monsters, Inc.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: A gentle and beautifully animated Studio Ghibli film based on the same source material as The Borrowers.

metas.name: Porco Rosso
metas.description: An adventurous Ghibli tale about a flying pilot that fans of Castle in the Sky will enjoy.

metas.name: Whisper of the Heart
metas.description: A sweet, grounded Ghibli story about finding your creative path, similar to Turning Red.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: The first installment of the heartwarming bear's adventures in London, filled with family-friendly charm.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A hilarious and stylistically bold adventure about a family saving the world from a robot apocalypse.

metas.name: Nimona
metas.description: A unique fantasy adventure with themes of acceptance and friendship, perfect for fans of Raya.

metas.name: Home
metas.description: A goofy and colorful alien adventure that focuses on an unlikely friendship, similar to Lilo & Stitch.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: A story about a brave dog on a cross-country journey who learns what it really means to be a hero.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A musical comedy from the perspective of a wise class lizard, similar to the humor in Sing.

metas.name: Smallfoot
metas.description: A clever and musical flip on the Bigfoot legend that emphasizes curiosity and truth.
